name: SQL query built with string formatting (sqlite3)
attack_scenario: An attacker sets userName to ' OR '1'='1' -- (or a stacked ...; DROP TABLE users; --) so the interpolated query changes meaning, letting them read every row, bypass auth checks, or destroy local data.
negative_test_hint: set userName to "' OR '1'='1' -- " and assert the query matches no row or errors instead of returning every user row

exemplar.explanation: Assembling SQL via stringWithFormat/sprintf mixes untrusted input with query syntax — SQL injection (OWASP MSTG-CODE-8, CWE-89). Binding values with sqlite3_bind_* keeps user data out of the query string so it can never change the statement's meaning.
